subject.title: fix(qa): repair WhatsApp live scenario regressions

question: Should the runtime-reload base at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110762 land before this QA follow-up, with this branch rebased and its live WhatsApp fleet rerun afterward?
rationale: The branch explicitly depends on an open sibling PR for its base, and the supplied live evidence covers their combined behavior rather than an independently merged mainline state.

options.title: Land base, then rebase QA follow-up
options.body: Merge the runtime-reload repair first, rebase this QA branch onto the resulting main head, and rerun the live selected-account scenario fleet.

options.title: Review and merge as one ordered stack
options.body: Keep both PRs open as an explicitly ordered stack only if maintainers want to validate and land their combined behavior together.

recommendation.title: Land base, then rebase QA follow-up
recommendation.body: Merge the runtime-reload repair first, rebase this QA branch onto the resulting main head, and rerun the live selected-account scenario fleet.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both sides of the current stack and can provide the exact post-rebase live proof.
